description.value: The Raj Indian Kitchen is an authentic Indian restaurant in the heart of downtown Kamloops, serving a wide range of traditional dishes from butter chicken and tikka masala to regional specialties, all prepared with fresh ingredients. The restaurant offers a comfortable dine-in experience alongside online ordering for pickup and phone-in takeout. A large share of the menu — including all tandoori, rice, and entree categories — is explicitly labelled gluten-free, making it a practical stop for cyclists with dietary restrictions.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms name, address (438 Victoria St, Kamloops, BC V2C 2A7), and phone (778-471-4111) matching OSM. The site explicitly offers online ordering for pickup and mentions takeout alongside dine-in service, and the menu prominently labels multiple categories as 'All Gluten Free' with a dedicated 'Veg Entree' section. However, every page on the website displays all seven days as 'Closed' in the business hours widget, directly conflicting with the OSM opening_hours tag; this ambiguity about current operating status warrants a needs_review flag.
concerns: Website hours widget shows Monday–Sunday as 'Closed' on every page, conflicting with OSM opening_hours (Thu–Sun evenings, Fri–Sat lunch). Could indicate permanent closure or a misconfigured widget — recommend phone or in-person verification.
